issues.description: The problem statement refers to the SealSaloon.orders attribute as a modifiable List<Meal> in one place but later instructs to add meals to the "array of orders." The provided solution and the template helper utilities (ArrayHelpers) use arrays (Meal[]). This inconsistency between 'List' and 'array' can confuse students about which collection type they should implement and expect in tests or examples.
issues.suggestedFix: Choose one collection approach and make it consistent across the problem statement, template, and solution. Either: (A) Update the problem statement and UML to require an array-based orders field (Meal[] orders) and keep ArrayHelpers as-is; or (B) Change the template and solution to use a List<Meal> (e.g., ArrayList) and update examples and helper utilities accordingly. Also ensure the problem text consistently refers to the chosen type (always 'array' or always 'List').
